plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to eliminate high risk.
Reduce exposure in QQQI, SMH, CRWD, and SPY to lower concentration.

conservative.read: This plan targets ~1.5% per month with a focus on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, holding a larger cash buffer for safety. Expect lower volatility but also slower growth.

balanced.read: This plan targets ~2.5% per month with a risk-first approach to growth. It cuts leveraged ETFs and reduces concentration while adding quality names. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

This plan embraces higher leverage and concentration for growth.

It concentrates capital in top-performing tech names and AI/Software, while reducing broad market and income exposure. Expect significant upside potential but also substantially higher drawdowns and leverage decay risk.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs and high-beta tech/semis (SOXL, SPAL, SMH, CRWD).
Increase allocation to QQQI for income generation.

income.read: This plan targets ~1% per month, focusing on stable monthly income and capital preservation. It shifts the portfolio towards income-generating assets like QQQI and reduces volatile tech and leveraged ETFs. Expect lower growth but more reliable distributions and reduced downside risk.
